declare function mapLimit<T>(
	items: T[],
	width: number,
	op: (x: T) => Promise<void>,
	retries?: number,
): Promise<void>;
declare const lib: { mapLimit: typeof mapLimit };
declare const items: number[];
declare function op(x: number): Promise<void>;

// CASE retries_one_fourth_arg expect=pass
export async function c1() {
	await mapLimit(items, 8, op, 1);
}

// CASE nested_option_limit_one expect=pass
export async function c2() {
	await (lib.mapLimit as any)(items, op, { retry: { limit: 1 }, width: 8 });
}

// CASE width_expression expect=pass
export async function c3(n: number) {
	await mapLimit(items, n - 1, op);
}

// CASE first_arg_one expect=pass
export async function c4() {
	await (mapLimit as any)(1, items, op);
}

// CASE literal_one expect=fire
export async function c5() {
	await mapLimit(items, 1, op);
}

// CASE string_one expect=pass
export async function c6() {
	await (mapLimit as any)(items, "1", op);
}
